review_candidates.title: HPC Systems Engineer, Linux Patching and Platform Reliability
review_candidates.description: Description Invent the future with us. Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing by developing SoCs and platform solutions focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable AI compute for cloud, edge, and physical applications. AI is showing up in essentially every part of the technology landscape, and we’re focused on delivering the performance, efficiency, and reliability those workloads require. Ampere is building compute silicon and platforms for AI applications spanning a broad range of industries. We focus on solving exciting challenges in areas such as robotics and automotive, among others, but the core of our work is enabling efficient AI at scale and across multiple application domains. About the role: In this role, you will own the technical strategy, operating model, automation, validation, and continuous improvement of patching for a large Unix/Linux-based EDA and high-performance computing environment. This role is responsible for building a repeatable, low-risk, evidence-based patching service across HPC farm support world class highly complex microprocessors, including RHEL compute nodes, virtual infrastructure, login servers, LSF infrastructure, RHEL IdM/IPA, storage-adjacent services, Perforce, MySQL, engineering tools, and supporting lab infrastructure. The successful candidate will combine strong Linux systems expertise with large-scale automation, disciplined change management, vulnerability remediation, performance validation, and the ability to partner effectively with EDA/design engineering teams. What you'll achieve : Patching Program Leadership Establish and operate the enterprise Linux patching program, including policy, standards, operational procedures, RACI, SLAs, exception handling, and executive reporting. Lead a team of Linux Patching / Platform Engineers and coordinate cross-functional participation from Infrastructure, Security, Network, Storage, EDA Applications, LSF, DevOps, and Engineering teams. Define patch prioritization based on vulnerability severity, exploitability, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV), asset criticality, exposure, compensating controls, and business impact. Establish standard and emergency patching paths with documented approval, testing, communication, rollback, and post-implementation review requirements. Ensure the program supports the SLA for patching. Automation, Repositories, and Engineering Workflow Implement and operate a dev ops patch lifecycle which includes Vendor advisory / mirror intake Patch repository Development/test repository Production-approved repository Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to create, test, approve, promote, deploy, verify, and roll back patch bundles. Integrate patch validation and promotion workflows with Jenkins and Git-based code-review/build processes where required. Develop and govern Ansible automation for RHEL and Ubuntu patch deployment, pre-checks, post-checks, reboots, service validation, evidence capture, and rollback actions. Establish secure internal package repository practices using Red Hat Satellite and/or equivalent RHEL content-management tooling, plus controlled Ubuntu/APT repositories where needed. Drive infrastructure-as-code, configuration-baseline, and configuration-drift management practices. Automate daily health checks across multiple LSF clusters and generate actionable operational and capacity-utilization reports. EDA / HPC Validation Partner with stakeholders to define representative patch validation workloads. Establish and maintain different test cases and performance benchmarks. Own technical go/no-go criteria for promoting tested patch bundles to production. Validate IBM Spectrum LSF scheduler health after patching, including node lifecycle, job submission/execution, queue capacity, licensing, slot allocation, and utilization reporting. Support patching and validation of hybrid HPC / cloud-bursting environments, including AWS-hosted compute capacity where applicable. Security, Compliance, and Reporting Monitor and assess vendor advisories, CVEs, Red Hat Security Advisories (RHSA), Ubuntu Security Notices (USN), IBM/LSF, Perforce, MySQL, virtualization, storage, and relevant EDA-tool advisories. Integrate vulnerability scanner findings, EDR status, CMDB data, SIEM logging, and asset criticality into remediation decisions. Produce management dashboards for patch compliance, SLA performance, critical vulnerability exposure, deployment success rate, failed-package rate, test pass rate, exception aging, and risk acceptance. Ensure patching evidence is retained for audits and supports NIST CSF, internal policy, customer, and contractual requirements. About you: B.Tech in Electronics Engineering or Computer Engineering with 8+ years, or M.Tech with 6+ years of experience 6+ years of progressive experience administering and engineering Linux environments, with significant experience in RHEL-based enterprise environments. 4+ years designing or leading patching, vulnerability remediation, configuration management, or platform reliability programs at scale. Strong hands-on experience with: RHEL, RPM/DNF/YUM, kernel lifecycle, repositories, and package dependency management. Red Hat Satellite, Foreman/Katello, or equivalent enterprise patch/content-management platforms. Ansible / Ansible Automation Platform, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure automation. Linux troubleshooting, boot/reboot recovery, systemd, networking, DNS, NFS, LDAP/FreeIPA/IdM, SSH, and performance analysis. Demonstrated experience managing Linux environments in large scale EDA environment. Experience with structured change management, emergency change procedures, rollback planning, and maintenance-window execution. Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with highly technical engineering users. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting semiconductor, EDA, HPC, compute farm, simulation, or large build-farm environments. Experience with IBM Spectrum LSF or another workload scheduler. Support patching and validation of hybrid HPC / cloud-bursting environments, including AWS-hosted compute capacity where applicable. Experience with VNC tools, Perforce, MySQL, NFS/Isilon/NetApp, Xen/XOA, virtualization, and container platforms. Experience integrating patch management with vulnerability scanners, SIEM, EDR/XDR, Prometheus, ELK, Jira, or similar platforms. Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, RHCE, RHCA, or equivalent. Experience with NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks, and Linux hardening standards. What we’ll offer: At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay,cash long-term incentiveand comprehensive benefits. Benefits highlights include: Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits includingcrechereimbursement, as well as a retirement plan,so thatyou can feel secure in your health,financial futureand child care during work. Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are passionate about inventing industry leading cloud-native designs that contribute to a more sustainable future. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

review_candidates.description: Acerca de The EPCM Group The EPCM Group es una empresa global de ingeniería y fabricación con operaciones en Canadá, Chile, Sudáfrica, México e India. Acerca del cargo Buscamos un/a Administrador/a de Sistemas bilingüe para integrarse a nuestro equipo global de TI. El cargo tiene alcance global, sede presencial en Santiago y reporta al Vicepresidente de TI. Será responsable de las operaciones de TI, la seguridad, los activos, los respaldos y la tecnología de las instalaciones en todas las regiones, con el objetivo de que cada una cumpla y mantenga los estándares globales de The EPCM Group. Responsabilidades principales •      Gestión de activos: inventario global de TI y ciclo de vida completo, con conciliaciones mensuales entre InvGate, TeamViewer, Active Directory e Intune. •      Respaldo y recuperación: diseño y operación de respaldos Veeam en todas las regiones, copias externas inmutables y pruebas de restauración documentadas. •      Seguridad: operación de Microsoft Defender for Endpoint y Defender XDR, respuesta a alertas, parches y endurecimiento, y programa global de concientización en phishing. •      Identidad y Microsoft 365: AD híbrido, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint e Intune; apoyo en Windows LAPS y passkeys. •      Redes: firewalls SonicWall, VPN entre sedes y switches/Wi-Fi UniFi. •      Tecnología de instalaciones: AV, CCTV, control de acceso y cableado en Santiago; supervisión de contratistas y soporte básico a sistemas de planta. •      Automatización e IA: automatización con PowerShell, adaptación de scripts (p. ej., Python) y uso seguro de herramientas de IA como Claude y Microsoft Copilot. •      Servicio y documentación: tickets InvGate según SLA, soporte de primer nivel en SAP Business ByDesign, documentación bajo estándares EPCM e informes mensuales en inglés. •      Gestión de proyectos: planificación y ejecución de proyectos de TI en cualquier región, coordinando proveedores y equipos internacionales. Requisitos •     5 años o más en administración de sistemas en organizaciones multisede, idealmente en más de un país. •     Español nativo e inglés profesional (MCER C1). •     Experiencia práctica con Defender for Endpoint/XDR, Intune, Entra ID y AD híbrido. •     Diseño y administración de Veeam Backup & Replication. •     PowerShell intermedio y nociones de otro lenguaje de scripting. •     Gestión de activos con herramienta ITSM. •     Experiencia en AV y cableado de baja tensión. •     Gestión de proyectos de TI de principio a fin, incluidos proveedores remotos. •     Uso de herramientas de IA en el trabajo técnico diario. •     Sólidas habilidades de documentación, comunicación escrita y análisis. •     Proactividad, organización y capacidad de relacionarse con equipos de distintos países y culturas. •     Licencia de conducir y pasaporte vigentes; disponibilidad para viajes ocasionales, incluidas instalaciones industriales. Deseable •     Certificaciones Microsoft SC-200, MD-102 y/o Veeam VMCE. •     Experiencia con SonicWall y UniFi, y en programas de concientización en seguridad. •     Formación en gestión de proyectos (Google PM, CAPM o equivalente). •     Experiencia en minería, fabricación o entornos industriales. •     Conocimientos de SAP Business ByDesign u otro ERP en la nube. Envía tu CV a reclutamiento.tc@tecnologiascobra.cl , indicando en el asunto : Administrador de Sistemas, TI Global . Únete a The EPCM Group y contribuye a una operación tecnológica global, segura y conectada. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- About The EPCM Group The EPCM Group is a global engineering and manufacturing company with operations in Canada, Chile, South Africa, Mexico and India. About the Role We are seeking a bilingual Systems Administrator to join our global IT team. This is a global role based on-site at our Santiago office, reporting to the Vice President of IT. You will be responsible for IT operations, security, assets, backups and facilities technology across all regions, bringing each one up to The EPCM Group global standards and keeping it there. Key Responsibilities •      Asset management: global IT inventory and full asset lifecycle, with monthly reconciliations across InvGate, TeamViewer, Active Directory and Intune. •      Backup and recovery: design and operate Veeam backups across all regions, maintain off-site immutable copies and run documented restore tests. •      Security: operate Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Defender XDR, respond to alerts, apply patching and hardening baselines, and run the global phishing awareness program. •      Identity and Microsoft 365: hybrid AD, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint and Intune; support the Windows LAPS and passkeys rollout. •      Networking: SonicWall firewalls, site-to-site VPNs, and UniFi switches and Wi-Fi. •      Facilities technology: AV, CCTV, access control and cabling in Santiago; supervise contractors and provide basic support for plant systems. •      Automation and AI: automate tasks with PowerShell, adapt scripts (e.g., Python) and use AI tools such as Claude and Microsoft Copilot securely. •      Service and documentation: resolve InvGate tickets within SLA, provide first-level SAP Business ByDesign support, document to EPCM standards and deliver monthly reports in English. •      Project management: plan and deliver IT projects in any region, coordinating vendors and international teams. First 90 Days •     Complete knowledge transfer for the Santiago office. •     Reconcile the global asset inventory and report exceptions by region. •     Bring all assets up to The EPCM Group security baseline. •     Deliver a global Veeam coverage report with restore tests per region. •     Take ownership of the global phishing simulation program. Requirements •     5+ years of systems administration in multi-site organizations, ideally across more than one country. •     Native Spanish and professional English (CEFR C1). •     Hands-on experience with Defender for Endpoint/XDR, Intune, Entra ID and hybrid AD. •     Veeam Backup & Replication design and administration. •     Intermediate PowerShell and basic knowledge of another scripting language. •     Asset management experience using an ITSM tool. •     Hands-on AV and low-voltage cabling experience. •     Proven ability to manage IT projects end to end, including remote vendors. •     Day-to-day use of AI tools in technical work. •     Strong documentation, written communication and analytical skills. •     Proactive, organized and able to work well across countries and cultures. •     Valid driver's license and passport; willingness to travel occasionally, including to industrial sites. Preferred •     Microsoft SC-200, MD-102 and/or Veeam VMCE certifications. •     Experience with SonicWall and UniFi, and with security awareness programs. •     Project management training (Google PM, CAPM or equivalent). •     Experience in mining, manufacturing or industrial environments. •     Knowledge of SAP Business ByDesign or another cloud ERP. Conditions •      Location: Santiago, Chile, fully on-site. •      Schedule: full-time, 42 hours per week, with flexibility to work with other time zones. •     Occasional travel to EPCM sites. How to Apply Send your CV to reclutamiento.tc@tecnologiascobra.cl with the subject line: Administrador de Sistemas, TI Global . Join The EPCM Group and help build a global, secure and connected technology operation.
